crash_patterns_found.issue: getMockLessonById now returns `| undefined` and the only consumer guard in app/lesson/[id].tsx uses bracket lookup without Object.hasOwn — a /lesson/constructor deep link bypasses the `!lesson` guard and crashes when reading .challenge.options
app/lesson/[id].tsx handleCheck: move isPromptingHeartsRef guard to the top and add drawerStatus guard — otherwise rapid taps stack Alerts and double-decrement hearts.

app/lesson/[id].tsx: isPromptingHeartsRef is only released via Alert button onPress or onDismiss, and onDismiss is unreliable on Android with cancelable:false — force-quit during the refill prompt permanently locks the lesson into silent no-op, exactly the team blind spot already recorded.

isPromptingHeartsRef and isContinuingRef can stay stuck true after force-quit or Android OS-dismiss (Alert.alert cancelable:false + no onDismiss cleanup) — makes CHECK and CONTINUE silent no-ops for the rest of the session; this is a recurrence of a known team blind spot.

app/lesson/[id].tsx (and previously elsewhere): guard refs (`isPromptingHeartsRef`, `isContinuingRef`) are released only inside Alert button callbacks; with `cancelable:false` on Android `onDismiss` never fires and the lesson permanently soft-locks. Fix with unmount-time cleanup or a shared useGuardedAlert hook, and stop relying on onDismiss.

Alert guard refs in app/lesson/[id].tsx are released only in positive button callbacks (never destructive path or onDismiss) — a 4th recurrence of the repo's most persistent bug class, causing permanent lockouts on the continue/refill paths.
app/(tabs)/index.tsx builds currentIndex from a flat map while rendering per-unit — S-curve drift; and getMockLessonById now returns undefined for every external caller, a latent TypeError.

getMockLessonById return type narrowed to optional while only the new [id].tsx caller was updated — every other caller is now a latent TypeError at next compile; either keep the non-null throwing contract or add a separately-named tryGet accessor.
Throwing twin getMockLessonById is exported but unused while tryGetMockLessonById was narrowed to optional — latent TypeError trap; delete the throwing twin.
getMockLessonById and mockLessonData both narrowed to non-nullable → optional while no strict throwing accessor is exported — every unconverted caller is a latent TypeError.
